An '''injector pen''', also known as a '''safety stick''', was an injector filled with a sedative agent used for self-defense. [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] was given one for her own protection, and used it to help subdue [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]].<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
